key_decisions.rationale: Renders the Greek outsider label neutrally while keeping exceptional kindness, weather, fire, and universal welcome.
key_decisions.before: The local people showed us extraordinary kindness. They lit a fire and welcomed all of us because it was raining and cold.
key_decisions.after: The local people showed us extraordinary kindness. Because of the rain and cold, they kindled a fire and welcomed all of us.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: And the natives were showing us unusual kindness, for they kindled a fire and welcomed us all because of the rain that had set in and because of the cold.

key_decisions.rationale: Preserves exact interval, ship's origin, wintering, island, and pagan emblem.
key_decisions.before: After three months we sailed in an Alexandrian ship that had wintered on the island and had the Twin Gods as its figurehead.
key_decisions.after: After three months, we set sail on an Alexandrian ship that had wintered at the island and bore the Twin Gods as its figurehead.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: And after three months we set sail in a ship of Alexandria that had wintered in the island, with the Twin Gods as figurehead.

key_decisions.rationale: Preserves disagreement, departure, single concluding word, Spirit, prophetic mediation, name, and ancestors.
key_decisions.before: Since they disagreed with one another, they began to leave after Paul made one final statement: “The Holy Spirit spoke rightly through Isaiah the prophet to your ancestors,
key_decisions.after: They disagreed with one another and began to leave after Paul made this one statement: “The Holy Spirit rightly spoke through the prophet Isaiah to your ancestors,
